title: Obesity is a National Security Issue: Lieutenant General Mark Hertling at TEDxMidAtlantic 2012
summary: Lieutenant General Mark Hertling gives a TEDx talk arguing that obesity and poor youth fitness are a national security problem because too few young Americans can meet military physical requirements.
why: HN cites it in threads on military recruiting and obesity as an early warning from a senior general that still applies.

quote.text: In 2012 Lieutenant General Mark Hertling had a TED talk [1] about this very issue and I think it still very much applies today.
